musicbrainzFirst.intro: Find a recording in MusicBrainz to choose its artist and year. A title is enough; add the artist if the right version is missing.
musicbrainzFirst.enterTitle: Enter a recording title to start searching.
musicbrainzFirst.chooseRecording: Choose the right recording. If the original version is missing, add the artist or refine the title.
musicbrainzFirst.noResults: No recordings found. Check the title, add the artist, or paste a Spotify link below and enter the details manually.
musicbrainzFirst.findingSpotify: Finding a Spotify link for the selected recording…
musicbrainzFirst.chooseSpotify: This recording has several Spotify links. Preview them and select the right link.
musicbrainzFirst.linkFound: Found a Spotify link attached to this recording in MusicBrainz. Check the preview and continue.
musicbrainzFirst.noSpotify: The title, artist and available year have been kept. No Spotify link was found — find it on Spotify or paste it below.
musicbrainzFirst.linksUnavailable: The selected recording details have been kept. Spotify links could not be loaded — paste a link below or try again.
musicbrainzFirst.suggestedSpotify: Suggested Spotify link — check the preview before selecting it. It may lead to a different recording version.
musicbrainzFirst.musicbrainzLinks: Links attached to the selected recording in MusicBrainz.
musicbrainzFirst.previewCandidate: Suggested track preview — select its link to use it on the card.
musicbrainzFirst.haveSpotifyLink: I have a Spotify link / find on Spotify
